defects.description: Task Attempt claim must activate exactly one matching coordination dispatch.
gate-evaluate can report completion without changing target rows, producing a completed-no-advance wedge.
defects.location: external GSD engine gate persistence/advance guard

recommended_content.title: GSD auto-mode claim-dispatch desync and completed-no-advance wedges
reproduction: Run auto-mode through an execute-task or gate-evaluate transition using the affected durable lifecycle adapter.
Observe that a Task Attempt claim does not activate exactly one matching coordination dispatch, or that gate completion leaves target rows unchanged.
Observe the resulting blocked auto-exit/liveness wedge and record the unit journal and activity references.
recommended_content.expected: The claim has exactly one matching active coordination dispatch, and a successful gate-evaluate completion advances or durably changes its target rows.
recommended_content.actual: The claim/dispatch invariant or row-advance invariant can fail, leaving auto-mode blocked.
recommended_content.requested_fix: Repair the external engine's dispatch activation and gate completion advance guards, and add regression coverage for both invariants without requiring law-nexus-local mutations.

boundary: This note records typed upstream debt only. It does not file an issue, modify the external GSD engine, or claim either defect is fixed.
